label: pardoned soldier convicted of killing wounded Palestinian
detail: Israeli President Isaac Herzog expunged the criminal record of former soldier Elor Azaria, who was convicted of manslaughter for shooting and killing wounded Palestinian Abdel Fattah al-Sharif in Hebron in March 2016. Herzog shortened the remaining erasure period on Azaria's record despite opposition from the Israeli military.
source_title: Israel’s president pardons soldier who killed wounded Palestinian in 2016

label: announced a binding security agreement giving the US permanent control over Greenland's security
detail: Denmark announced a binding agreement with the United States giving Washington permanent control over Greenland's security and barring Russian and Chinese military bases from the Arctic territory. Danish Foreign Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen stated the agreement strengthens security in the Arctic and North Atlantic while respecting the Danish Kingdom's red lines, with Denmark and Greenland to sign the agreement at the UN General Assembly in New York.
source_title: Denmark says ‘binding’ US deal on Greenland won’t compromise sovereignty

label: announced creation of 'AI Force' and appointment of new 'AI czar'
detail: US President Donald Trump announced he is creating an 'AI Force' and will appoint a new 'AI czar' to oversee development of the nation's artificial intelligence industry, stating the goal is to protect and advance AI development as 'the next Industrial Revolution' key to economic growth.
source_title: Trump says he will create ‘AI Force’ with new ‘AI czar’

label: conveyed formal conditions for ending war via Qatar mediators
detail: Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei told Al Jazeera that Iran has conveyed formal conditions to Washington through Qatari mediators for ending the war, including an end to hostilities on all fronts, release of frozen funds, and an end to the naval blockade. Rezaei stated Iran is awaiting President Trump's response.
source_title: Iran says conditions to re-engage in talks, end war sent to US via Qatar

label: conducted air strikes targeting paramedics in southern Lebanon
detail: Israel conducted two back-to-back air strikes in Nabatieh, southern Lebanon, and a third strike targeted an ambulance team responding to the attacks. This occurred during the Israel-Hezbollah war that began on 2 March 2026.
source_title: Israel targets paramedics in southern Lebanon

label: announced plan to create 'AI Force' and appoint an artificial intelligence czar
detail: Donald Trump said he would appoint an artificial intelligence czar and create an 'AI Force' to help monitor technology, stating he would announce the AI czar in the near future. Trump framed AI as the next industrial revolution and vowed his administration would not hinder the growth of the AI industry.
source_title: Trump to create ‘AI Force’ to monitor technology as fears over out-of-control agents grow

label: hosted Canadian Prime Minister on symbolic visit to French territory
detail: French President Emmanuel Macron hosted Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on a three-day visit to Saint Pierre and Miquelon, a French archipelago off Canada's Newfoundland. This was the first-ever visit by a Canadian prime minister to the territory, occurring amid growing tensions between Canada and the United States and discussions of Canada becoming an EU associate member.
source_title: French outpost off Canada in the spotlight as Macron hosts Carney on symbolic visit

label: announced formation of 'AI Force' and appointment of artificial intelligence tsar
detail: US President Donald Trump announced his administration will form an 'AI Force' and appoint an artificial intelligence tsar. Trump stated the administration will not hinder or stifle AI industry growth and pushed back against calls to slow AI development until better safeguards are in place.
source_title: Trump says US will form 'AI Force' and appoint an artificial intelligence tsar

label: backs Saudi Arabia's security and considers support amid Houthi attacks
detail: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan stated that Saudi Arabia may have unmet military needs from Houthi attacks and that Turkey would consider how to support the kingdom as part of the trilateral Mecca Joint Defence Agreement. Fidan also said it was unacceptable for Saudi Arabia to be drawn into the US-Iran conflict.
source_title: Turkiye backs Saudi Arabia’s security amid escalating Houthi attacks: FM
